test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The two sides CB and BA of triangle ABC are produced to CE and BD, respectively, in such a way that angle DAC = 110° ; and angle ABE = 130° . Which of the following options is true?
solution:
**Given:**

CB and BA are produced to CE and BD respectively

∠DAC = 110°

∠ABE = 130°

**Formula used:**

Exterior angle = Sum of interior opposite angles

Greater angle subtends greater side

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd4a70841b683640ca58e12bb7a0b91de44ce5cf133908e40ea9fcd076c40246.png] 

∠DAC is exterior angle at A

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 110°

∠ABE is exterior angle at B

⇒ ∠BAC + ∠ACB = 130°

Subtracting first from second

⇒ (∠BAC + ∠ACB) − (∠ABC + ∠ACB) = 130° − 110°

⇒ ∠BAC − ∠ABC = 20°

⇒ ∠BAC > ∠ABC

From ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 110°

⇒ ∠ACB is the smallest angle

⇒ ∠ACB < ∠ABC < ∠BAC

⇒ Opposite sides:

AB < AC < BC

**∴ The correct option is: AB < AC < BC.**
